$comment: Agent manifest — the §3 PRD table as machine-readable data.

owned_globs is the FILE-OWNERSHIP dimension of Guarantee #5 (machine-checkable).
The SEMANTIC dimension (a decision buried inside an allowed file) is NOT in here —
it stays human/Sentinel judgment. Do not treat this file as full lane automation.
Globs are gitignore-style (fnmatch over forward-slash repo-relative paths).
This same file is the intended data source for the Phase-2 agent skills.
